premises.text: 900 million people spend 20 hours a week acting as if their job is to process their inbox
premises.evidence_span: 900 million people spend 20 hours a week acting as if their job is to process their inbox

premises.text: Priorities come from various sources including emails and thoughts
premises.evidence_span: your inbox has priorities, but so do they come out of your mind, and they come out of meetings

premises.text: Capturing all priorities in one place is necessary for making good decisions
premises.evidence_span: You have to get them all in one place to make good decisions

premises.text: Triage is necessary for making decisions on every item when you see it
premises.evidence_span: Triage is making decisions on every item when you see it

premises.text: The Handle habit is essential for completing important work
premises.evidence_span: we call this the Handle habit, and it's the reason why email clients have not been able to solve this problem alone

premises.text: Handle provides a unique element called the Handlebar for efficient email triage
premises.evidence_span: we've created a unique element we call the Handlebar

premises.text: Handle allows users to manage tasks and priorities effectively
premises.evidence_span: Handle's priority list is full, is ordered by importance, with must-dos at the top

premises.text: Handle helps users focus on important work without context switching
premises.evidence_span: I can jump in and be productive immediately. No context switching

premises.text: Handle is disruptive because it helps users complete must-do tasks
premises.evidence_span: The disruption is getting all the must-do things you have to do done that day

value.text: Users can focus on what they feel is most important and complete their tasks
value.evidence_span: it's about you and doing what you feel is most important

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
